decisions.summary: The research runs in fresh headless page sessions from briefs generated by briefs/gen.py (write from the inventory, checks from the handoff), queued as then: steps; not in the orchestrating session.
decisions.why: FR-005 requires page sessions from briefs; the GM asked for the landed procedure. gen.py puts every inventory item R01-R53 in exactly one write brief, carries 265's list, canon once, source-pages, ONE source-reader, WHOLE=1 for a registered source (250 D19), the cap, the tests and a handoff.

decisions.summary: Ten groups of at most eight items, run one after another in this clone.
decisions.why: Grouping and serial execution are how, not what. The count is now right: G1 7 + G1B 6 = thirteen with R53; G3 6 + G3B 4 = ten.

decisions.summary: Each group owns a free prefix range on its page.
decisions.why: Collision avoidance for NEW questions; since the B1 fix, step 4 of the write brief lets a correction land on any page at any prefix, so the range no longer confines corrections.

decisions.summary: No section on 265's derived list is edited while 265's task for its page is open; owed edits (R27, R42, R46 and any a handoff names) are made in T17 once ticked.
decisions.why: FR-006 as written; the brief HEAD carries the same list as the spec's Edge Cases, and the edit is made, not linked.

decisions.summary: Four outcomes in the handoff and outcomes.md; a CONTRADICTION-RESOLVED corrects the wrong section, cited, in its write session on any page and prefix (a 265-list section's correction goes to the handoff for T17), the corrected section is a SECTION= line so the check sessions check it; the orchestrator reads G1's handoff (G1 ran on the old brief) and makes and checks any correction it only named.
decisions.why: Resolves last round's B1. FR-001 'the record corrected, cited' and the spec's 'a link alone does not resolve a contradiction' are now carried: gen.py WRITE step 4 says a CONTRADICTION-RESOLVED is not done until the wrong section is corrected in the session, step 6 makes the corrected section a SECTION= line, and CHECK builds its sessions from SECTION= lines, so the correction is quote-checked and record-format checked. Confirmed in the nine regenerated briefs (g1b, g2, g3, g3b, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8 each carry the new step 4); g1-write.md does not, which is the case the orchestrator path covers. The 265 exception is FR-006's, not a new carve-out.

decisions.summary: Kinds (Entry, label, prose; entry-drift on a bundle) and sheets (redraw, picture and pack audit, building-review; knobs in each sheet's notes, sheets differing where the record allows) follow in the orchestrating session, per group, after its checks.
decisions.why: FR-003 and FR-004 as written; FR-005's page-session procedure governs the research, and the kinds and sheets are code and drawings.

decisions.summary: The GM's items, and any research result the GM must rule on, go through escalation-check.
future-work/compounds.md 'Research owed' rewritten at the end to what remains, each with why.
Check sessions: two questions each, new keys with the last; one re-check round, a PARTIAL left after it labeled honestly in the note.
decisions.why: Feature 250's landed brief pattern; FR-005 requires that procedure.
